description_target.target_text: each red rect: green border max(h,w)/2 thick + blue stem at red cols from below border to grid bottom; green overrides stem

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  (define bg 0)
  (define rects
    (map (lambda (o)
           (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                  (rs (map first cells))
                  (cs (map second cells))
                  (r1 (apply min rs)) (r2 (apply max rs))
                  (c1 (apply min cs)) (c2 (apply max cs))
                  (rh (+ (- r2 r1) 1))
                  (rw (+ (- c2 c1) 1))
                  (border (quotient (max rh rw) 2)))
             (list r1 c1 r2 c2 border)))
         (objects-8 g bg)))
  (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
  (define after-stems
    (reduce (lambda (gg rect)
              (let* ((r1 (first rect)) (c1 (second rect))
                     (r2 (third rect)) (c2 (nth rect 3))
                     (border (nth rect 4))
                     (stem-start (+ r2 border 1)))
                (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                          (set-cell gg2 (first rc) (second rc) 1))
                        gg
                        (filter (lambda (rc) (in-b (first rc) (second rc)))
                                (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                           (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                         (range stem-start h))))))
            g
            rects))
  (define after-borders
    (reduce (lambda (gg rect)
              (let* ((r1 (first rect)) (c1 (second rect))
                     (r2 (third rect)) (c2 (nth rect 3))
                     (border (nth rect 4))
                     (br1 (- r1 border)) (br2 (+ r2 border))
                     (bc1 (- c1 border)) (bc2 (+ c2 border)))
                (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                          (let ((r (first rc)) (c (second rc)))
                            (if (and (in-b r c) (not (= (cell-at g r c) 9)))
                                (set-cell gg2 r c 3)
                                gg2)))
                        gg
                        (filter (lambda (rc)
                                  (let ((r (first rc)) (c (second rc)))
                                    (or (< r r1) (> r r2) (< c c1) (> c c2))))
                                (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                           (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                (range bc1 (+ bc2 1))))
                                         (range br1 (+ br2 1)))))))
            after-stems
            rects))
  after-borders))
